_comment: Justified divergences between the `just check` target list and .github/workflows/ci.yml job names. Every entry MUST carry a non-empty reason; false records a known, deliberate omission.

divergences.name: classify-changes
divergences.reason: Hosted changed-files classifier for pull-request and canonical-push base/head pairs. Local just check has no event pair to classify; its production script is exercised by check-docs-only-ci instead.

divergences.name: check-charters
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate to enforce shipped charter-defect detectors over this repo's two enumerated charters; this factory slice may not edit .github/workflows/ to add the matching CI matrix job.

divergences.name: check-ci-parity
divergences.reason: Runs in CI as a literal `just` line inside the check-metadata-batch job (livespec-console-beads-fabro-wzrct7), which batches every canonical livespec-dev-tooling check under one container setup the way livespec-runtime's check-metadata-batch does, rather than as a CI job of its own name; check-ci-matrix-completeness reads those lines.

divergences.name: check-fork-drift
divergences.reason: Runs in CI as a literal `just` line inside the check-metadata-batch job (livespec-console-beads-fabro-wzrct7), which batches every canonical livespec-dev-tooling check under one container setup the way livespec-runtime's check-metadata-batch does, rather than as a CI job of its own name; check-ci-matrix-completeness reads those lines.

divergences.name: check-fuzz
divergences.reason: Merge-gate fuzz run (livespec-console-beads-fabro-txtzn5.9). Deliberately absent from the `just check` aggregate: SPECIFICATION/non-functional-requirements.md ratifies that `just check` MUST NOT include fuzz runs. At >=60s per target across three targets it is also a minutes-long floor by construction, which is not what a local pre-commit aggregate is for.

divergences.name: check-heading-coverage-debt-register
divergences.reason: Runs in CI as a literal `just` line inside the check-metadata-batch job (livespec-console-beads-fabro-wzrct7), which batches every canonical livespec-dev-tooling check under one container setup the way livespec-runtime's check-metadata-batch does, rather than as a CI job of its own name; check-ci-matrix-completeness reads those lines.

divergences.name: check-mutants
divergences.reason: Merge-gate mutation run (livespec-console-beads-fabro-txtzn5.10). Deliberately absent from the `just check` aggregate: SPECIFICATION/non-functional-requirements.md ratifies that `just check` MUST NOT include mutation runs. It also cannot run there — it needs a base ref to diff against, which a local aggregate invocation has no way to supply.

divergences.name: check-no-workflow-edits
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate only, BY DESIGN (livespec-dev-tooling-fy02): the pack body dev-tooling/check-no-workflow-edits.sh is an authorship control at the agent boundary and is a deliberate no-op when GITHUB_ACTIONS is set — CI has no local author to control, and the fleet's bot lanes (pin bumps, the canonical-slug reconciler, release-please) legitimately rewrite workflow files there. Master is protected by PR gate ≡ master gate, which this guard neither weakens nor strengthens, so a CI job would be vacuous rather than merely un-added.

divergences.name: check-plan-anchor-declared
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate to enforce the opt-in plan lifecycle anchor convention; this factory slice may not edit .github/workflows/ to add a new CI job.

divergences.name: export-telemetry
divergences.reason: Closed-loop Honeycomb CI telemetry export (the fleet-standard export-ci-telemetry.sh); needs gh API access to the run's own job data and a Honeycomb ingest secret, neither of which a local `just check` invocation has.

divergences.name: check-plan-record-conformance
